meta_characteristic: Decentralized finance application: a financial service built on smart contracts on a public blockchain without intermediaries

dimensions.name: Primary financial function
dimensions.definition: The core financial service that the DeFi application provides to its users.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify each application by the single financial service that is its main value proposition; if several apply, use the one generating most of its transaction volume.

characteristics.name: Lending and borrowing
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to lend assets to or borrow assets from a pool or counterparty.

characteristics.name: Trading and exchange
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to swap or exchange crypto-assets.

characteristics.name: Asset management and yield generation
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to deposit assets to earn returns through strategies or yield aggregation.

characteristics.name: Payments and stablecoin transfers
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to transfer value or hold and move stable-valued tokens.

characteristics.name: Derivatives and synthetic assets
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to trade contracts or tokens that derive their value from underlying assets.

characteristics.name: Insurance and risk coverage
characteristics.definition: The application enables users to hedge or insure against risks such as smart contract failure.

characteristics.name: Other financial service
characteristics.definition: The application provides a financial service not covered by the previous characteristics.

dimensions.name: Revenue model
dimensions.definition: The mechanism through which the application generates value for its operators or token holders.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by the primary mechanism that captures value; if the application generates no revenue for operators or token holders, use the last characteristic.

characteristics.name: Transaction fee-based
characteristics.definition: Value is captured through fees charged on each transaction executed in the application.

characteristics.name: Interest margin-based
characteristics.definition: Value is captured through the spread between interest paid to depositors and interest charged to borrowers.

characteristics.name: Token-based value capture
characteristics.definition: Value is captured through a native token whose holders benefit from protocol revenue, incentives, or governance rights.

characteristics.name: No direct revenue capture
characteristics.definition: The application does not capture revenue for operators or token holders.

dimensions.name: Governance model
dimensions.definition: The way decisions on the protocol's rules and parameters are made and by whom.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by the actor group that holds effective decision-making power over protocol changes.

characteristics.name: On-chain token-holder governance
characteristics.definition: Protocol changes are decided by token holders through on-chain voting, often organized as a decentralized autonomous organization.

characteristics.name: Core team or foundation governance
characteristics.definition: Protocol changes are decided by a identifiable development team, company, or foundation.

characteristics.name: Immutable without active governance
characteristics.definition: The protocol's rules are fixed after deployment and cannot be changed by any actor.

dimensions.name: Access model
dimensions.definition: The conditions under which users can access and use the application.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by whether users must pass any identity or eligibility check before interacting with the application.

characteristics.name: Permissionless access
characteristics.definition: Any wallet holder can interact with the application without identity verification or whitelisting.

characteristics.name: Permissioned access
characteristics.definition: Users must pass identity verification, whitelisting, or another eligibility check before using the application.

dimensions.name: Blockchain platform
dimensions.definition: The public blockchain on which the application's smart contracts are deployed.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by the blockchain hosting the application's main smart contracts; if deployed on several, use the one hosting the core contracts.

characteristics.name: Ethereum mainnet
characteristics.definition: The application's core smart contracts run on the Ethereum mainnet.

characteristics.name: Other EVM-compatible public blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application's core smart contracts run on a public blockchain compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine other than Ethereum mainnet.

characteristics.name: Non-EVM public blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application's core smart contracts run on a public blockchain that is not compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

dimensions.name: Price discovery mechanism
dimensions.definition: The mechanism by which the application determines prices or interest rates for its transactions.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by the mechanism that sets prices or rates for the main service; if the service sets no prices or rates, use the last characteristic.

characteristics.name: Automated market maker
characteristics.definition: Prices are set algorithmically by liquidity pools using a predefined pricing function.

characteristics.name: Order book
characteristics.definition: Prices are set by matching buy and sell orders placed by users.

characteristics.name: Algorithmic interest rate model
characteristics.definition: Interest rates are set algorithmically based on pool utilization or supply and demand.

characteristics.name: No price or rate setting
characteristics.definition: The application does not set prices or rates for its main service.

dimensions.name: External data dependence
dimensions.definition: Whether the application depends on data from outside the blockchain to operate.
dimensions.application_rule: Classify by whether the application's core logic requires external price or event data delivered by oracles.

characteristics.name: Relies on external oracle data
characteristics.definition: The application's core logic depends on external data, such as asset prices, delivered to the blockchain by oracles.

characteristics.name: Operates without external data
characteristics.definition: The application's core logic operates solely on data available on the blockchain.
